mutations.name: KB-76 thread insert back on account membership (viewers write)
mutations.sql: drop policy narrative_threads_insert on public.narrative_threads; create policy narrative_threads_insert on public.narrative_threads for insert to authenticated with check (exists (select 1 from public.projects p where p.id = narrative_threads.project_id and public.has_role_on_account(p.account_id)));

mutations.name: KB-76 world-state update without WITH CHECK (a row can be moved to another project's episode)
mutations.sql: drop policy world_states_update on public.world_states; create policy world_states_update on public.world_states for update to authenticated using (public.can_write_project(project_id));

mutations.name: KB-76 summary writes on account membership
mutations.sql: drop policy episode_summaries_insert on public.episode_summaries; create policy episode_summaries_insert on public.episode_summaries for insert to authenticated with check (exists (select 1 from public.episodes e join public.projects p on p.id = e.project_id where e.id = episode_summaries.episode_id and public.has_account_access(p.account_id)));

mutations.name: KB-76 act-bridge delete on account membership
mutations.sql: drop policy act_context_bridges_delete on public.act_context_bridges; create policy act_context_bridges_delete on public.act_context_bridges for delete to authenticated using (exists (select 1 from public.episodes e join public.projects p on p.id = e.project_id where e.id = act_context_bridges.episode_id and public.has_account_access(p.account_id)));

mutations.name: KB-76 sequel context may name a parent the writer cannot read
mutations.sql: drop policy sequel_parent_contexts_insert on public.sequel_parent_contexts; create policy sequel_parent_contexts_insert on public.sequel_parent_contexts for insert to authenticated with check (public.can_write_project(sequel_project_id));

mutations.name: KB-76 thread DELETE granted back to authenticated
mutations.sql: grant delete on public.narrative_threads to authenticated;

mutations.name: KB-77 character-state insert does not pin the author
mutations.sql: drop policy character_states_insert on public.character_states; create policy character_states_insert on public.character_states for insert to authenticated with check (exists (select 1 from public.assets a join public.episodes e on e.project_id = a.project_id where a.id = character_states.character_id and e.id = character_states.episode_id and public.can_write_project(a.project_id)));

mutations.name: KB-77 character-state insert does not check the episode is the character's project
mutations.sql: drop policy character_states_insert on public.character_states; create policy character_states_insert on public.character_states for insert to authenticated with check (created_by = (select auth.uid()) and exists (select 1 from public.assets a where a.id = character_states.character_id and public.can_write_project(a.project_id)));

mutations.name: KB-77 state-delta insert on account membership
mutations.sql: drop policy state_deltas_insert on public.state_deltas; create policy state_deltas_insert on public.state_deltas for insert to authenticated with check (exists (select 1 from public.episodes e join public.projects p on p.id = e.project_id where e.id = state_deltas.episode_id and public.has_role_on_account(p.account_id)));

mutations.name: KB-77 DELETE granted back on the append-only log
mutations.sql: grant delete on public.state_deltas to authenticated;

mutations.name: KB-77 anon privileges back on the canon tables
mutations.sql: grant select on public.character_states to anon;

mutations.name: KB-63 remove_episode_from_threads_touched without its check
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.remove_episode_from_threads_touched(p_episode_id uuid, p_project_id uuid) returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$ begin update public.narrative_threads set episodes_touched = array_remove(episodes_touched, p_episode_id), updated_at = now() where project_id = p_project_id and p_episode_id = any(episodes_touched); end; $$;
